svg.title: MusicPlayground — Green Vinyl
svg.desc: A finely engraved charcoal vinyl record with recessed grooves and directional edge reflections on an emerald green field, with a mint green label and a slender translucent white curved tonearm with a coupled headshell, cartridge, and fine stylus contacting a groove. Small tonal letterpress lettering reading MusicPlayground repeats four times around the entire label. All artwork and lettering are vector paths.
